Mac preview

DMC Player for your Mac.

A first preview of the small player for gaming. Native macOS playback, a borderless mini window and searchable M3U lists — with a smaller feature set than Windows.

Preview 0.1.0

Available for Apple silicon & Intel

Requires macOS 13 Ventura or later. One universal ZIP works on Apple silicon and Intel Macs.

This is an early preview. Read the supported features below before downloading.

Download the Mac preview ↗

Install on macOS

Unzip, move, open.

  1. 1

    Download the Mac ZIP

    Use the Mac section on our download page. The Windows EXE and portable ZIP do not run on macOS.

  2. 2

    Move the app

    Open the ZIP in Finder and drag DMC Player.app to Applications. Keep the app bundle intact.

  3. 3

    Open DMC Player

    Use File → Open File for a video or File → Open Stream for a direct media address.

About the first-launch prompt

This preview is ad-hoc signed, without an Apple Developer ID certificate, and is not notarized. macOS may block the first launch.

If you trust the downloaded package, try opening it, then use System Settings → Privacy & Security → Open Anyway for DMC Player. Availability can depend on your Mac’s security policies. See Apple’s instructions for opening an unverified app.

Start watching

Your media, in a smaller window.

Open an MP4, MOV or supported audio file, or paste an HTTP/HLS media link. The preview uses Apple’s native playback engine; MKV, AVI and the Windows player’s full VLC format and protocol range are not included.

Import a local M3U with File → Open File, or paste a playlist URL into File → Open Stream. Use File → Playlist Library to browse the imported entries, search titles and filter by group. Choose what to play. Lists stay in memory for this session. They are not a saved library or an automatic queue.

Direct streams reconnect after interruptions while playback is wanted. Pause, Stop or choose another source to cancel recovery. Seeking and restoring a movie’s position depend on the stream supporting them.

Mac shortcuts

Go small. Keep playing.

⌥⌘M
Mini / normal window
⌥⌘L
Lock / unlock mouse click-through
⌃⌘O
Open a file
⌃⌘L
Open a stream or playlist
⌃⌘F
Toggle fullscreen
Esc
Unlock, then leave fullscreen or mini mode while the player has focus

⌥ is Option, ⌘ is Command and ⌃ is Control. Mini and lock shortcuts can work while another app has focus. Lock is available only if the global unlock shortcut registers successfully.

Drag the mini picture to move it, resize its edges and double-click the unlocked picture to restore the normal window. Hover over it for controls. Use ⌥⌘L to unlock when clicks are passing through to your game.

Use a windowed or borderless game where possible. Whether a floating window appears above a fullscreen game depends on the game, its display mode and macOS.

Experimental websites

Service pages are still a preview.

Services and File → Open Website open pages in WKWebView. Each provider handles sign-in, cookies, subscription and regional requirements. A page opening does not mean its video will play.

Protected Netflix, Prime Video and Disney+ programme playback has not been verified. Website playback is experimental; it does not use the native file player or its stream recovery. Watch together, chat, add-ons and torrents are not part of this Mac preview.

The preview has no automatic updater. To update, quit DMC Player and replace the app with a newer official Mac download. See Mac privacy details.
